title: Capability adoption profile v1 / 能力采用 profile v1
description: Declares one application's complete explicit capability selection, desired lifecycle states, and bounded presentation metadata. / 声明一个应用的完整显式能力选择、期望 lifecycle 状态与受限呈现 metadata。

adoptionVersion.description: Adoption contract version. / 采用契约版本。

kind.description: Separates this application profile from business and engineering manifests. / 将此应用 profile 与业务及工程 manifest 区分。

capabilities.description: Complete desired capability set; runtime validation enforces unique module and implementation IDs. / 完整期望能力集合；runtime 校验 module 与 implementation ID 唯一性。

dottedIdentifier.description: Stable lowercase dotted identifier. / 稳定的小写点分标识。

simpleIdentifier.description: Stable lowercase identifier. / 稳定的小写标识。

state.description: Desired process-local lifecycle state. / 期望的进程内 lifecycle 状态。

blocks.description: Selected host-registered blocks and allowlisted visibility values. / 选择的宿主已登记区块及 allowlist visibility 值。

order.description: Every selected block ID exactly once; runtime validation enforces set equality. / 每个已选择区块 ID 精确一次；runtime 校验集合相等。

pageSize.description: Initial framework allowlist; a host may permit a subset. / 框架首轮 allowlist；宿主可只允许其子集。
